notes_for_us: Grapple anchors are the movement system of this game and there is no option for them. The distinction the prompt makes - grappling a small item pulls it to you, grappling a platform pulls you to it - is a property of specific pieces of geometry, and the only way to record it was a typed free-text Marker.

'And anything else you can think of that a game like this needs' is the opposite of the refusal case layout-intake handles. The skill has a rule for a prompt that forbids questions and a rule against injecting unrequested options, but nothing for a prompt that explicitly authorises additions, so the safe reading and the requested reading point in opposite directions.
island-cluster was the nearest row for floating platforms in vacuum, and its wording assumes land and water. Bending it worked, but the ID will read as terrain to anyone counting.
